This '''unidentified alien bounty hunter''' was among the many [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] applicants who arrived aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] to join the hunt for [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].

==Behind the scenes==
The character highlighted in this article is standing second from left in the infobox image, between [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and a [[Unidentified Bosph bounty hunter|Bosph]] bounty hunter.
